seo.title: Essential Tools for Web3 Product Managers
seo.description: A curated list of tools for Web3 product managers covering analytics, community insights, roadmap planning, and crypto-native tooling.

content.intro: Web3 product management requires unique tools for on-chain analytics, community-driven development, and decentralized team coordination. Here are the essentials.

items.name: Dune Analytics
items.description: SQL-based blockchain analytics. Query any on-chain data.

items.name: Nansen
items.description: Wallet labeling and smart money tracking.

items.name: Artemis
items.description: Cross-chain analytics and protocol comparisons.

items.name: Token Terminal
items.description: Financial metrics for protocols. Revenue, fees, valuations.

items.name: DefiLlama
items.description: DeFi TVL and protocol analytics. Free and comprehensive.

items.name: PostHog
items.description: Open source product analytics. Self-hostable for privacy.

items.name: Mixpanel
items.description: Event-based product analytics with cohort analysis.

items.name: Amplitude
items.description: Product analytics with behavioral cohorts.

items.name: Spindl
items.description: Web3-native attribution and analytics.

items.name: Linear
items.description: Modern issue tracking. Fast and keyboard-driven.

items.name: Notion
items.description: Docs, wikis, and lightweight project management.

items.name: Productboard
items.description: Product management platform for roadmapping and feedback.

items.name: Canny
items.description: Feature request tracking and roadmap communication.

items.name: Fibery
items.description: Customizable work management. Good for unique workflows.

items.name: Discord Analytics Bot
items.description: Track Discord engagement and activity.

items.name: Commonroom
items.description: Community intelligence platform. Track engagement across platforms.

items.name: Snapshot
items.description: Governance voting platform. Understand community preferences.

items.name: Figma
items.description: Collaborative design tool. Industry standard.

items.name: Whimsical
items.description: Flowcharts, wireframes, and mind maps.

items.name: Miro
items.description: Online whiteboard for collaboration.

items.name: Loom
items.description: Quick video recording for async communication.

items.name: Messari
items.description: Crypto research and data. Protocol reports and metrics.

items.name: The Block Research
items.description: Crypto news and research. Data dashboards.

items.name: Etherscan
items.description: Ethereum block explorer. Essential for understanding transactions.

items.name: L2Beat
items.description: Layer 2 analytics and risk analysis.

sections.heading: Web3 User Research
sections.description: Tools for understanding Web3 users specifically.

items.name: Arkham Intelligence
items.description: Wallet labeling and entity identification at scale.

items.name: Flipside Crypto
items.description: Community-driven analytics with bounty programs.

items.name: Persona
items.description: Identity verification for compliance-heavy products.

items.name: Chainalysis
items.description: Blockchain compliance and risk analysis.

sections.heading: Collaboration and Communication
sections.description: Tools for async and distributed teams.

items.name: Gather Town
items.description: Virtual office for remote teams. Good for casual sync.

items.name: Tally
items.description: On-chain governance interface and proposal creation.

items.name: Guild.xyz
items.description: Token-gated access management for communities.

proTips.tip: Build custom Dune dashboards for your specific product metrics.
Combine on-chain and off-chain analytics for full picture.
Use Snapshot polls for lightweight community feedback before building.
Learn basic SQL to query Dune yourself. It is invaluable.
Track wallet addresses, not just pageviews. On-chain is the source of truth.
